scope.usage_scope: this run's registered CLI attempts, deduplicated by attempt; excludes Supervisor and external billing

supervisor_checks.latency_scope: recorded due/queue/ack boundaries; client-side cause remains unknown

time.wall_includes: queue, pause and waiting; never a sum of concurrent calls

observed_waits.retention: partial lifecycle history; missing boundaries remain unknown
observed_waits.scope: union of observed scope waits, possibly concurrent with sibling CLI work; do not subtract from wall time

time.unavailable: historical missing wait boundaries, child-session usage, and model-only time
time.cli_scope: cumulative monotonic transport including setup, termination, parsing and usage observation; parallel calls overlap
time.processing_scope: Runner checks/processing; estimated crash intervals are separately marked

rejection.summary: approval needs a short handoff (<=1200 characters, <=20 nonempty lines)

verification.authority: evidence_only; no approval, dispatch or publication
